value.rationale: The output is a sharp, attained calibration of how bounded multiplicative error in row-selection residuals changes expected one-step numerical progress. The extremal residual imbalance and exact high-power e^{-4ε} limit determine a natural reliability frontier independent of row angles and step relaxation. It addresses the motivated fresh-correction/stale-selection gap without claiming a full asynchronous convergence theorem.
